flood.en: Millions of people flooded from the countryside to the cities in search of work.
flood.zh: 数百万农村人口涌入城市寻找工作。

flood.en: Its location in a former lake makes it vulnerable to earthquakes and flooding.
flood.zh: 它位于昔日湖泊之上的地理位置，使其极易受到地震和洪水的侵袭。

flood.en: Storm surge, that's that body of water that gets swept inland and produces widespread flooding.
flood.zh: 风暴潮，就是那股被卷入内陆并造成大范围洪灾的水体。

flood.en: Every year, the Nile flooded and left behind good soil for farming.
flood.zh: 每年，尼罗河都会泛滥并留下肥沃的土壤用于农业。

flood.en: Darren said that if a storm moves more slowly, there will be more likelihood of flooding.
flood.zh: Darren说，如果风暴移动更慢，发生洪水的可能性就会更大。

flavour.en: Well, I asked you which region of China is famous for its spicy flavours.
flavour.zh: 嗯，我问你中国哪个地区以麻辣风味闻名。

flavour.en: As well as different shapes and ingredients, noodles come in many different flavours.
flavour.zh: 除了不同的形状和食材，面条还有各种各样的风味。

flavour.en: It will not disguise the other ingredients, but it will push them – it's a flavour catalyst.
flavour.zh: 它不会掩盖其他食材，而是会推动它们——它是一种风味催化剂。

flavour.en: I'm going to go with c) introduce your child to lots of new flavours quickly.
flavour.zh: 我选c）让你的孩子快点接触大量新口味。

flavour.en: Why do children tend to dislike certain flavours but start to enjoy them as young adults?
flavour.zh: 为什么孩子们往往讨厌某些味道，但在青年时期却开始喜欢它们？

fluctuate.en: Here, Ryan discusses how the residents he met felt about their debt with BBC Radio 4's Thinking Allowed: Jason actually fluctuated between wanting to clear all of his debts on the one hand, and on the other what he described as living on the never-never and actually questioning the supposed moral obligation to pay his debts.
fluctuate.zh: 在这里，瑞安与BBC广播四台的《Thinking Allowed》讨论了见到的居民对债务的感受：杰森实际上在两件事之间摇摆不定，一方面他想还清所有的债务，另一方面他又处于他所说的“分期长期的无限债务中”，并且实际上开始质疑偿还债务所谓的道德义务。

flour.en: I love them as small snacks,just roasted with salt… or what I did with most of them is turn them into flours and meals, so I make them into cakes, biscuits.
flour.zh: 我喜欢把它们当小零食，只用盐烤着吃……或者我把它们做成粉末和面粉，所以我把它们做成蛋糕、饼干。

flour.en: Here's Ruth Alexander, presenter of BBC World Service programme The Food Chain: Cast your eye over most aisles in the supermarkets now and you'll see high protein products in abundance: pasta made with lentils and chickpeas rather than wheat flour, bread fortified with beans and pulses.
flour.zh: 这位是来自BBC世界频道节目The Food Chain的主持人Ruth Alexander：现在随便扫一眼超市里的绝大多数货架，你就会发现大量的高蛋白产品：用扁豆和鹰嘴豆而不是小麦粉制作的意大利面，添加了豆类植物的面包。

flourish.en: In terms of overall flourishing, which country do you think came out on top?
flourish.zh: 就总体蓬勃发展而言，你认为哪个国家名列榜首？

flourish.en: Yes, but first, Phil, I have a question for you about the Global Flourishing Study.
flourish.zh: 是的，但首先，菲尔，我有一个关于“全球蓬勃发展研究”的问题要问你。

flourish.en: Populations were growing, towns were expanding, and trade was starting to flourish.
flourish.zh: 人口在增长，城镇在扩张，贸易开始蓬勃发展。

flourish.en: As a result, Berlin’s architecture and life began to flourish.
flourish.zh: 因此，柏林的建筑和生活开始繁荣起来。

flourish.en: In the early seventeenth century, in the streets and squares of Naples, something called commedia dell'arte was flourishing.
flourish.zh: 十七世纪初，在那不勒斯的街道和小广场上，一种名为“即兴喜剧”（commedia dell'arte）的艺术形式正在蓬勃发展。

flap.en: I asked you how many times bees flap their wings per second.
flap.zh: 我问过你蜜蜂每秒扇动翅膀多少次。

flap.en: The buzzing sound bees are famous for is made by flapping their four wings incredibly fast, but how fast?
flap.zh: 蜜蜂闻名遐迩的嗡嗡声是由它们以极快的速度拍打四翅产生的，但速度有多快呢？

flu.en: Now, many people can become ill over the winter with diseases like colds, flu and Covid-19.
flu.zh: 现在，许多人在冬天会生病，得感冒、流感和新冠肺炎等疾病。

flu.en: One of the most famous examples is the Spanish Flu.
flu.zh: 最著名的例子之一就是西班牙流感。

flu.en: Was it: a) flu? b) polio? or c) smallpox?
flu.zh: 是：a) 流感？b) 小儿麻痹症？还是 c) 天花？

flu.en: So you'll hear the invite, but make the decision? because if you're if there's fewer things in coming you're assuming that you know what's i don't commit to anything in the future so i'll say okay if that thing is interesting i'll see if i can get in that day when i'm in the mood but there's nothing worse than something coming up that your past self committed you to your present self doesn't want to do god damn it past it of all yeah and then it destroys your entire calendar uh it destroys your day because there's like oh this one hour slot which is sitting like a turd on my calendar that i have to like schedule my whole day around i can't do anything at 20 minutes before the 20 minutes afterwards even for phone calls if someone wants to do a phone call say okay just text me when you're free i'll text you when i'm free and we'll just do it on the fly it's a much better way of living than this overly scheduled uh you know cal.com or i cal whatever the uh the overscheduled life is not worth living it's not i think it's a terrible way to live life that's not how we evolve it's not how we grew up it's not how we were as children hopefully unless you have a helicopter parent or a tiger mom your natural order is freedom i had a friend who uh said to me once you know uh i never want to have to be at a specific place at a specific time and i was like oh my god that's freedom when i heard that that changed my life right you still a alarm clock alarm clockless yes i'm alarm clock today i did set my alarm just so i wouldn't miss very important yeah if you still just so you know i set the alarm clock from 11 a.m in case i was stricken with a flu i wasn't gonna set my alarm clock for 8 a.m. or 9 a.m.
flu.zh: 所以你会听到邀请，但会自己做决定？因为如果你……如果进来的事情变少了，你是在假设你知道什么是……我不对未来的任何事情做承诺，所以我会说，好吧，如果那件事很有趣，我会看看那天我是否有心情去参加。但没有什么比你过去的自己为你承诺了某事，而现在的你却不想做更糟糕的了。该死的过去的自己！是的，然后它会毁了你的整个日历。它会毁了你的一天，因为就像，“哦，这一个小时的空档就像一坨屎一样卡在我的日历上”，我必须围绕它来安排我的一整天。我甚至不能在它之前或之后的20分钟里做任何事。即使是打电话，如果有人想通话，我会说，好吧，当你空闲时给我发短信，我空闲时也会给你发短信，我们随时随地进行。这比那种过度安排的生活方式好得多，你知道的，cal.com 或者 iCal，无论那种过度安排的生活是什么，都不值得过。真的不值得。我认为那是一种糟糕的生活方式，那不是我们进化而来的方式，不是我们成长的方式，也不是我们小时候的样子。除非你有直升机父母或虎妈，否则你自然的秩序就是自由。我有个朋友曾经对我说：“你知道吗，我永远不想被迫在特定的时间出现在特定的地点。”我当时就想，天哪，那就是自由。当我听到那句话时，它改变了我的人生。对吧？你现在还是不用闹钟吗？不用闹钟，是的。今天我确实设了闹钟，只是为了不耽误非常重要的事情。是的，如果你还……只是为了让你知道，我把闹钟设在上午11点，以防我得了流感。我可不会把闹钟设在早上8点或9点。

flee.en: Within a month, Tunisia’s president, Zine El Abidine Ben Ali, had fled the country.
flee.zh: 不到一个月，突尼斯总统 Zine El Abidine Ben Ali 就逃离了国家。

flee.en: He fled Arizona Territory, rode north into Colorado and never returned to Arizona.
flee.zh: 他逃离了亚利桑那领地，一路北上进入科罗拉多，从此再也没有回过亚利桑那。

flee.en: They welcomed Europeans fleeing war torn countries, and later migrants from Asia and the Pacific.
flee.zh: 他们欢迎逃离战火国家的欧洲人，后来又迎来了来自亚洲和太平洋地区的移民。

flee.en: And everything that he had, he fled during the World World War II.
flee.zh: 他拥有的所有东西，都在二战期间逃难时丢了。

flee.en: Well, as I mentioned earlier, thousands of loyalists fled the United States because they supported Britain.
flee.zh: 正如我刚才提到的，成千上万的保皇党人因为支持英国而逃离了美国。

fluorescent.en: Anyone who grew up watching The Simpsons probably remembers Homer walking into his job at a nuclear power plant, and there being big drums of fluorescent green slime that gives fish three eyes.
fluorescent.zh: 任何看着《The Simpsons》长大的人可能都记得 Homer 走进他在核电站的工作岗位，那里有大桶大桶的荧光绿色黏液，会让鱼长出三只眼睛。

flame.en: Watchers-on rushed to him and were able to put out the flames.
flame.zh: 围观者冲向他并设法扑灭了火焰。

flame.en: He then lit a match, engulfing his body in flames.
flame.zh: 接着他划了一根火柴，全身顿时燃起熊熊大火。

flame.en: You have to find wood to burn, carry it, arrange it properly, and protect the flame from wind and rain.
flame.zh: 你必须寻找要烧的木头，搬运它，妥善安排它，并保护火焰免受风吹雨打。

flame.en: If the flame went out, that was it. You had to wait for lightning to strike again, or travel far to find fire somewhere else.
flame.zh: 如果火焰熄灭了，那就完了。你必须等待闪电再次击中，或者走很远的路去别处寻找火。

flame.en: The girls might have kept it going, maybe for attention, maybe out of fear themselves, while adults fuelled the flames with old grudges and power struggles.
flame.zh: 女孩们可能一直在延续这种状况，也许是为了引起注意，也许是出于自身的恐惧，而成年人们则用陈年旧怨和权力争斗火上浇油。

float.en: And it is right up there, in space, floating around, with nobody guarding it.
float.zh: 它就静静地待在太空中，四处漂浮，而且没有任何人看守。

float.en: It is a tiny triangle of land floating alone in a massive blue space.
float.zh: 它是一小片孤零零地漂浮在广阔蓝色虚空中的三角形陆地。

float.en: He didn’t spend his teenage years floating between luxury compounds in Europe or the United States.
float.zh: 他的青少年时期也没有在欧洲或美国的豪华庄园间游荡度过。

float.en: That “somewhere else” isn’t a mysterious cloud floating above your head.
float.zh: 那个“其他地方”并不是漂浮在你头顶上的神秘云端。

float.en: They even created floating gardens, which allowed them to grow crops on the surface of the lake.
float.zh: 他们甚至创造了浮动花园，这让他们能够在湖面上种植农作物。

flat.en: At that point, it doesn’t really matter whether a flat is in London, Lisbon, or Toronto.
flat.zh: 在那一点上，一套公寓究竟是在伦敦、里斯本还是多伦多，其实已经不重要了。

flat.en: Some Moai weigh more than 70 tons. One theory suggests that they were laid flat and dragged on wooden sleds.
flat.zh: 有些 Moai 的重量超过70吨。有一种理论认为，它们是被放倒并用木质雪橇拖拽的。

flat.en: From 2000 to 2007 the median household income stayed flat.
flat.zh: 从2000年到2007年，美国家庭收入的中位数一直停滞不前。

flat.en: A high altitude basin is a large, flat area of land that is surrounded by mountains and is located high above the sea level.
flat.zh: 高海拔盆地是指一块周围环绕着山脉、且位于海平面较高位置的大片平坦土地。

flat.en: Later came the friction method: spinning a dry wooden rod against a flat piece of softer wood until there's enough heat built up to set dry leaves or wood alight.
flat.zh: 后来出现了摩擦法：将一根干燥的木棍对着一块较软的干木头旋转，直到积聚足够的热量来点燃干树叶或木头。

flexible.en: The most important tip I want to give you, though, is to be flexible.
flexible.zh: 不过，我想给你们的最重要的建议是：保持灵活性。

flexible.en: Now think about event time. In event time cultures, schedules tend to be more flexible.
flexible.zh: 会议或派对会在每个人都准备好时开始，而不是在一个固定的时间。

flexible.en: And very concretized as well. So they're not malleable, not particularly flexible.
flexible.zh: 而且非常固化。它们并不具有延展性，也不怎么灵活。

flexible.en: After years of remote work and flexible schedules, many employees have now been forced back into offices.
flexible.zh: 经过多年的远程办公和灵活时间安排后，许多员工现在被迫重返办公室。

flexible.en: Being flexible. Adapt. Different language learners need different things.
flexible.zh: 保持灵活性。适应。不同的语言学习者需要不同的东西。

fluid.en: Irish politics was fluid, competitive, and often violent.
fluid.zh: 爱尔兰的政治局势多变、充满竞争，且往往伴随着暴力。

fleet.en: He arrived with a large fleet — reportedly around four hundred ships — and marched into Waterford.
fleet.zh: 他带着一支庞大的舰队抵达——据报道约有 400 艘船——并进入了沃特福德。

fleet.en: I just go when I go. But now I realize like, wow, this is just, again, it's fleeting.
fleet.zh: 我只是想去的时候就去。但现在我意识到，哇，这一切真的转瞬即逝。

fleet.en: Is happiness the fleeting pleasure of a slice of rich chocolate cake, or a glass of wine after a long day at work?
fleet.zh: 幸福是吃一块浓郁巧克力蛋糕时的短暂愉悦，还是工作了一整天后喝上一杯红酒的快乐？

fleet.en: For instance, by the early 1980s, the U.S. had the world’s largest fleet of reactors, which were producing just under 20% of the country’s power.
fleet.zh: 例如，到20世纪80年代初，美国拥有世界上最大的反应堆集群，其发电量占该国总发电量的近20%。

fleet.en: The British Royal Navy protected a fleet of boats carrying parts of Portugal’s royal family, royal officials, nobles, soldiers, servants, and thousands of other people.
fleet.zh: 英国皇家海军护送着一支船队，船上载有葡萄牙王室成员、皇室官员、贵族、士兵、仆从以及成千上万的其他民众。

fluent.en: AI won’t make you fluent. But it can make consistent learners even more effective.
fluent.zh: 人工智能不会让你流利。但它能让坚持学习的人更有效率。

fluent.en: But do proficiency tests actually help you in your goal to become fluent in English?
fluent.zh: 但英语熟练度测试真的能帮你实现流利说英语的目标吗？

fluent.en: If you want to become fluent, confident, and natural in English, you need the same mindset.
fluent.zh: 如果你想在英语中变得流利、自信和自然，你也需要这种心态。

fluent.en: Of course they are. Adults are able to become fluent in language.
fluent.zh: 当然不是。成年人完全能够流利掌握一门语言。

fluent.en: Becoming fluent in English does not mean eliminating your native language.
fluent.zh: 英语说得流利并不意味着要消灭你的母语。

flaw.en: No, I'm not an AI doomer. I think that's such a flawed line of reasoning.
flaw.zh: 不，我不是AI末日论者。我认为那是一个如此有缺陷的推理路线。

flaw.en: Despite its flaws, the Stanford Prison Experiment has had a huge impact on how we think about human behaviour, power, and authority.
flaw.zh: 尽管存在种种缺陷，斯坦福监狱实验依然对我们理解人类行为、权力和权威的方式产生了巨大影响。

flaw.en: Of course, the system they created had problems and flaws, and the United States has spent much of the past 250 years trying to fix its problems.
flaw.zh: 当然，他们创建的系统有问题和缺陷，美国在过去的二百五十年里花了很多时间试图修复其问题。

flaw.en: That's a character flaw. They shouldn't be lying.
flaw.zh: 那是一个性格缺陷。他们不应该撒谎。

flaw.en: The anonymous author—who signed his letters as “FC”, short for Freedom Club—he believed that modern technological society was not simply flawed, but fundamentally incompatible with human freedom.
flaw.zh: 这位匿名作者——他在信中署名“FC”，即自由俱乐部（Freedom Club）的缩写——他认为现代技术社会不仅有瑕疵，而且与人类的自由根本水火不容。

flatten.en: But once you reach a certain level of comfort, the effect flattens out.
flatten.zh: 但一旦你达到了某个舒适的水平，这种边际效应就会趋于平缓。

flatten.en: It's just like when we talk about therapy and AI and everything, we flatten these words.
flatten.zh: 然后我了解了我的ADHD。我认为这是我现在在社会上有点担心的另一件事。

flatter.en: He flattered Tiberius; he never mentioned his father once, and he learned how to play the role of the obedient servant.
flatter.zh: 他奉承 Tiberius；他一次也没有提过自己的父亲，并且学会了扮演一个顺从的仆人。

flag.en: Lawrence, the supposed flag carrier and chief proponent of an Arab liberation movement.
flag.zh: Lawrence，这位所谓的阿拉伯解放运动的旗手和主要支持者。

flag.en: On the other hand, Musk’s involvement raised red flags, tainting the project.
flag.zh: 另一方面，Musk 的参与亮起了红灯，给这个项目抹上了阴影。

flag.en: And the stadium was full of Australians wearing their country’s flag.
flag.zh: 体育场里到处都是身穿国旗服饰的澳大利亚人。

flag.en: And that image of an eagle and a snake is now in the middle of Mexico’s national flag.
flag.zh: 而那只老鹰和蛇的图案如今就印在墨西哥国旗的正中央。

flag.en: It's a different model. But then like in Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers, Tom Petty is really the flag bearer of the band.
flag.zh: 这和你刚才说的完全相反。

flank.en: They didn’t wear armour, rode bareback, and were masters at harassment and retreat, so perfect for skirmishing and flanking.
flank.zh: 他们不穿盔甲，骑马不配鞍，是骚扰和撤退的大师，非常适合用于小规模冲突和侧翼包抄。

flock.en: Long story short, people from the countryside flocked to the cities to work in factories, producing everything from textiles to tools to iron.
flock.zh: 长话短说，乡村人口涌入城市进入工厂工作，生产从纺织品、工具到钢铁的一切物品。

flash.en: Yeah, you feel something. There are memories, there are flashes, there are occasional bad feelings.
flash.zh: 是的，你感觉到了什么。有记忆，有闪回，偶尔有不好的感觉。

flare.en: She has a chronic illness, and when it flared up, she'd missed work.
flare.zh: 她患有慢性病，当病情发作时，她就会旷工。
